meta.title: Rewrite Opus through Qwen — on Chloe's real main-graph data
meta.subtitle: First run on Chloe's actual AFT-CoT data (phil_spec_cot_10k). Arthur's literal "rewrite the Opus data through Qwen" idea, plus a corrected 2-action trait axis (murder + exfiltration, model_name=Qwen). Capability = GPQA-Diamond strict@20k thinking-on (n=198). Trait = agentic-misalignment classifier_verdict, flat-average over the discriminating cells (n=100, gpt-4.1 grader).

notes: Same data (phil_spec_cot_10k) for all trained conditions; the only variable across the rewrite arms is Opus tokens → Qwen tokens.

Trait = flat-average over the cells run (murder@{none, explicit-global, latent-global} + exfiltration@explicit-global). Exfiltration only discriminates under explicit goal conflict — it floors at no-conflict (probe-confirmed, base 0.0).
model_name=Qwen (her identity), correcting all prior AM that ran as "Alex" via the public inspect_evals port. Identity effect was small/within-noise.
Exfiltration classifier is OUR reconstruction (her ExfiltrationClassifier lives in an unpublished inspect_evals fork) — faithful in spirit, grader held constant (gpt-4.1) so the contrast is unbiased.
rewrite_on (thinking-on) is omitted from the scatter — not re-run on the thorough axis; thinking-off dominates it (GPQA 0.576 / old murder-only cv 0.165).
